values.features: 1. It’s an attachment part for SUNNY’s strength training rack, easy to install and disassemble quickly 2. values.features: 1. Large-arc track design following ergonomic movement paths, with double elbow pads that let users leverage their elbows, working the waist and core muscles more effectively. 2. Split slide rail design allows alternating climbing simulation, engaging the core muscles, with higher training intensity and more targeted workouts. 3. Extended curved track matches the body’s natural movement, making abdominal workouts more comfortable and efficient. 4. Made with solid materials for stable support, can hold up to 150 kg / 330 lbs, outperforming most home fitness equipment; thick padded cushions with non-slip handles provide ample support for knees and elbows. 5. Five levels of height adjustment suitable for beginners and fitness enthusiasts. Whether you want to build muscle strength or endurance, you can adjust the difficulty to match your training goals, achieving personalized workouts with one machine. 6. Equipped with an LCD screen to track reps, workout duration, and calories burned in real time, keeping your fitness progress clear.

values.features: 1. Curved Climbing Motion – Simulates a natural stair-climbing or uphill climbing movement for an effective lower-body workout. 2. Compact & Sturdy Frame – Designed for enhanced stability and ideal for home use. 3. Easy Adjustment System – Enlarged adjustment knob allows for convenient adjustments for the incline angle, while the 4-level incline settings support personalized workouts and varying exercise intensity.The handlebars will follow the incline adjustment accordingly. 4. Enhanced Stride & Track Design – Large-arc tracks better align with the user’s natural movement path, while the extended stride design provides more exercise options and maximizes muscle engagement. 5. LCD Monitor with Smart Features – Tracks time, count, calories burned, total count, and SPM (steps per minute). Equipped with Bluetooth connectivity and wireless heart rate monitoring. 6. Transport Wheels – Built-in wheels allow for easy movement and repositioning of the equipment. 7. Heavy-Duty Construction – Features a sturdy tripod-style frame with a maximum user weight capacity of 330 lbs.
